conversion.note: UCDP-equivalent battle deaths = factor x ACLED (Battles + Explosions/Remote violence) fatalities; fitted as the median log ratio on overlapping country-years (UCDP >= 25), mostly African wars.

intensity_12m.label: Deadly violence
intensity_12m.meaning: How many people were killed in political violence, relative to population.

escalation_3m.label: Escalation
escalation_3m.meaning: Whether killings rose or fell in the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.

unrest_z.label: Unrest signal
unrest_z.meaning: Protests and riots in the last 3 months vs the country's usual level.

cost_continue_h5.label: Cost if fighting continues
cost_continue_h5.meaning: How much poorer people would be in 5 years if today's fighting continued.

peace_dividend_h5.label: Gain from stopping now
peace_dividend_h5.unit: % points of GDP per person after 5 years
peace_dividend_h5.meaning: How much income is saved if fighting stops after this year instead of 4 more years.

extra_poor_h5.label: People pushed into poverty
extra_poor_h5.meaning: Extra people in extreme poverty if today's fighting continued for 5 years.

neighbor_exposure.label: Neighborhood exposure
neighbor_exposure.meaning: Income lost because of fighting in nearby countries, if it continues.
